promotion_policy.rule: Challenger models may only replace production baselines if they pass 100% of pre-frozen qualification gates, independent validation, and fresh holdout tests.

seed_governance.one_shot_rule: Every research seed is one-shot. If any gate fails, the seed is consumed as immutable evidence. No tuning against the same seed is permitted.
seed_governance.holdout_protection: Holdout seeds (e.g. 26186, 36186, 37186, 38186, 39186) remain ungenerated and untouched during development.

anti_leakage_policy.target_safety: Zero target-derived, future-derived, or latent variables exposed to feature extraction or inference pipelines.
anti_leakage_policy.cohort_isolation: Strict chronological splits and family isolation ensuring zero syndicate or mule overlap between train and test cohorts.

reproducibility_policy.deterministic_guarantee: All dataset generators and training scripts must produce byte-for-byte identical artifacts when run with fixed seeds and deterministic gzip configuration.

fallback_and_truthfulness_policy.provenance_transparency: Predictions produced by trained models are labeled 'trained_ml'. Demo cases are labeled 'deterministic_demo'. Out-of-scope complaints receive 'OUTSIDE_OPERATIONAL_SCOPE' with zero dummy scores.
fallback_and_truthfulness_policy.human_in_the_loop: Model outputs represent decision support intelligence for law enforcement and nodal banking officers. They are NOT autonomous execution, account freezing, or legal culpability determinations.

challenger_audit_summary.v5_series: Closed due to feature ambiguity in synthetic scenario generation.
challenger_audit_summary.v6_series: Closed due to the mathematical tension between conditional concentration and marginal diversity.
future_retraining_prerequisites: Availability of real anonymized NCRP outcome records.
Verified banking cash-out outcome corroboration signals.
Verified law enforcement agency recovery telemetry.
Consortium blockchain verified signal layer (Phase B).
